violations.why: irq_amber preempts irq_fern between the increment's write and the read-back, so the value read can differ.
irq_amber can write v_loom between fern's read and its later write.
irq_cobalt (higher priority) can reset v_loom between fern's write and read.
irq_cobalt preempts irq_amber between its write and its check read.
v_beacon++ in fern is non-atomic, and cobalt's reset in between is lost.
Cobalt resets v_ridge between fern's use as array index and the increment, so the index is stale.
v_ridge++ in fern is non-atomic, and cobalt's reset in between is overwritten.
